paite: Huan hiai vaihawmnate, ama ua na ngak dingte ahi uhi.
heading: Sikhate Bawldan / (Diu 15.12-18)

paite: Hebru sikha na leileh, kum guk sung nang nna asem ding a, akum sagihna ah bangmah pe lou in noplen in apawtkhe ding.
Ama tum a hong lut ahihleh, ama tum mah in apawtkhe ding. Zi nei ahihleh, azi in amah azuikhe ding.
Apu in zi apiak a, tapate hiam tanute hiam aneihsakleh, azi leh atate apu a ahi ding ua, amah kia in apawtkhe ding.
Sikha in teltak a, "Ka pu ka it, ka zi leh ka tate ka it; noplen in ka pawtkhe kei ding," achihleh;
apu in vaihawmte kiang ah amah api dia; kongkhak chiang ah hiam kongkhak khuam chiang ah hiam api dia, apu'n vuhna in abil avut pailet ding. Huchi in ama'n apu nna asem tawntung ding hi.
Mi'n sikhanu ding a atanu azuakleh, sikhapate bang in apaikhe kei ding.
Amah khampa, apu alung-kimsak keileh, apa atankiksak ding. Atung ah muanhuai loutak a ahihleh melmak nam kiang a zuak ding in thuneihna anei kei.
Atapa zi dia adeihleh, tanute bang in abawl ding hi.
Ama'n zi dang aneihthuahleh, a-an nek, apuansilh leh apiak ding a kilawm asukkiam louh ding ahi.
Atung a hiai thumte ahihkeileh, sum-le-pai pe lou in nonlen in apawtkhe ding ahi.
Asihna dia mi vua peuhmah, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
heading: Hiamgamna Toh Kisai Dante

paite: Mi'n thah ding a na buk lou ahih a, Pathian in akhut a amah apiakkhiakleh, ataikhiakna ding mun ka sehsak ding hi.
Himahleh mi khatpeuh in tupmawng in a-invengte tung ah gitlouh piltak in asihna ding in gamta taleh, ka maitam a pan amah na lakhe dia, asih ding ahi.
Kuapeuh apa hiam, anu hiam vomi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Kuapeuh mihing gu a zuakmi, ahihkeileh akhut ah muhkhiak a ommi, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Kuapeuh anu leh pa hamsiatmi, sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
Mite kisual uhenla, khat in khat suang in deng hiam, akhuttum hiam in tum henla, si lou in, lupna ngak taleh;
thou nawn in, chiangkhun khun in kholak vakleh, avopa ahul dia; ahun sukbei man ape dia, amah adamsiangsak sipsip ding hi.
Mi'n chiang in asikhapa hiam, asikhanu hiam sat henla, akhutlum in si taleh amah gawt ngeingei ding ahi.
Himahleh ni khat hiam, ni nih hiam nung a dam a, athohzohleh, gawt louh ding ahi; amah apu neihsa ahih ziak in.

Mite kisual in, numei gai lai hihna in, anau tolh henla, himahleh siatdetna in zui keileh; numeinu pasal in atung a, achih bangbang a gawt ngeingei ding ahi. Vaihawmte'n abikhiah bang uh aliau ding hi.
Siatna mawngmawng in zui taleh hinna tang a hinna apiak ding ahi.
Mit tang a mit, ha tang a ha, khut tang a khut, khe tang a khe.
Mei a hal tang a mei a hal, liam tang a liam, pawn tang a pawn.
Mi'n asikha mit hiam, asikhanu mit hiam suksak in, se taleh amit ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
Asikhapa ha hiam, asikhanu ha hiam sukhe taleh, aha ziak in noplen in akhah ding ahi.
Bawngtal in pasal hiam, numei hiam, asik ziak in si taleh; huai bawngtal denlup ngeingei ding ahi. Asa nek louh hial ding ahi. Himahleh abawngtal nei pen gawt louh in asuakta ding hi.
heading: Neitute Mohpuak

paite: Himahleh huai bawngtal amalam a, akii a misik hat hi a, aneitu kiang a hilhsa leng hinapi a, ama'n ana khum tuan lou ahihleh, pasal hiam, numei hiam ana siklupleh, huai bawngtal denlup ding ahi a; aneitu leng sihsak ding ahi.
Atung ah dangka sum akiphutleh, akiphut bangbang ahinna tatna man ding in ape ding ahi.
Tapa hiam, tanu hiam ana sikleh, hiai vaihawmna bang a, atung a hih ding ahi.
Bawngtal in sikhapa hiam sikhanu hiam asikleh, apu kiang ah dangka shekel sawmthum ape dia, bawngtal pen denlup ding ahi.
Pasal in kokhuk sin hong henla, ahihkeileh pasal in kokhuk tou henla, sin kei henla, asung ah bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam ke taleh,
kokhuk neitu in abawlhoih a, aneipa kiang a dangka sum apiak ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a ahi ding.
Mi khat bawngtal in midang khat bawngtal mah hih na kha henla, si taleh; abawngtal hing lai pen azuak ding ua, asum akihawm ding uhi. Abawngtal si pen leng akihawm ding uh ahi.
Ahihkeileh amalam a huai bawngtal sik hat ahi chih akitheih a, aneitu in akhum kei chih akitheihleh; bawngtal tang a bawngtal apiak ngeingei ding ahi. Huchi in aganta si pen amah a tuam ahi ding hi.
